Name: Ohodavi's Portraits for Xtardew Valley - Sexperimental Edition
Author: Kyoko21
Description:
This mod include Ohodavi style portraits for only [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27635]Xtardew Valley - Sexperimental Edition[/url] and no other mods

To [b]Install[/b] the Mod you need to [b]manually replace[/b] the portrait files of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27635]Xtardew Valley - Sexperimental Edition[/url] mod portraits
﻿by replace the [b]"asset"[/b] folder in the [b]"[CP] Xtardew Valley - Sexperimental Edition"[/b] mod folder
﻿or manually replace each portraits.png files to make sure they are replaced correctly.
